say:6:1611029003:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... You realize how serious this is, right? For the Serene Lyceum, for the royal court... this changes everything.

say:7:1611029004:0.text: Don't do anything rash. Right now, it's only speculation. We don't have the evidence to back it up.
say:7:1611029004:0.source_cn: 不要轻举妄动……目前的一切都是推测，我们手中并没有足够...

say:8:1611029005:0.text: If this isn't handled carefully, the repercussions across the empire could be catastrophic... It could shatter the balance between the Crown, the nobles, and the mages, and unleash a storm we can't control.
say:8:1611029005:0.source_cn: 这件事如果处理不好，会对帝国内部带来巨大的影响……甚至...

say:9:1611029006:1.text: This is urgent. I need to inform the <style="highlight">Queen</style> immediately and await her direct orders.

say:14:1611029010:0.text: This is no longer a simple investigation... it's a gathering storm. Any ship caught in it, big or small, could be dragged under.

say:15:1611029011:0.text: But no matter what happens, as the head of the Arcane Council, your first duty is to ensure its safety.
